name: NEC PC-FX
significance: A unique historical dead-end that rejected 3D polygonal accelerators in favor of 30 FPS full-screen JPEG anime playback, finding a cult niche in Japan.

verifiedFactualData.gpuOrVideoChip: Custom video chip capable of full-screen JPEG video decoding

editorialContent.overview: NEC's unique tower-chassis successor to the PC Engine, engineered entirely around anime Full-Motion Video decompression rather than 3D polygons.
